title: Whisper Me a Love Song
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: First-year Himari Kino, 15, falls for the singing of third-year Yori Asanagi, 17, frontwoman of the band SSGIRLS. Yori mistakes Himari's admiration for a romantic confession, falls for her and sets out to win her real love; Himari comes to love her back. Bandmates Aki and Shiho, a rival band and a past death in the group fill out the drama.
life_message: It holds up honest feelings, music made together and the courage to love openly.
